text:
Samir Patel: quick drop tried an 'error badge' (tiny pill with count) vs a full banner. which feels less noisy on long Settings forms? Jada Chen: badge feels lighter but might be missed. i like badge + expansion to list. microcopy: badge collapsed = '3 issues view' Toni M: accessibility: expanded view must get focus and announce counts. use aria-live=\"assertive\" on submit, aria-live=\"polite\" for blur hints. ensure inputs have aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Luis Gomez: delete flow: small deletes = inline confirm + undo toast. destructive = modal with typed-name. support saw 4 accidental deletes last quarter. typed confirm only for irreversible or multi-item deletes. Ava Li: mobile: banner pushes too much. badge that pins to header and expands inline is better. when expanded, links should move focus into the input. Samir Patel: proposal: inline-on-blur for required fields, badge shows only on submit errors, expandable to linked list. will add copy options for the badge and modal texts. Jada Chen: copy suggestions: badge collapsed: '3 issues view'; expanded header: 'We couldn't save. Fix the highlighted fields.' delete modal label: 'Delete workspace permanently' confirm button: 'Delete permanently' and typed input placeholder: 'type workspace name to confirm' Toni M: code hint: ```
3 issues
``` Toni M: when expanded set focus to the region and ensure each link has aria-label pointing to field name. Samir Patel: i'll spin a prototype with badge+expand and a modal typed-confirm pattern for deletes. will ping UX Writing for final microcopy. design-bot: created doc https://redwood/designs/error-badge-pattern 3 accessibility checklist and tracking (error fix time, undo rate, accidental deletes). Samir Patel: thanks please react with preferred pattern and i'll schedule a quick design review.
